title: ConnectionLost
description: The station is no longer connected. Published by the BROKER as the station's Last Will and Testament when the link drops without a clean MQTT DISCONNECT, or by the STATION itself, immediately before a clean DISCONNECT it performs on purpose. The `reason` says which.

reason.description: Why the station is gone. `UnexpectedDisconnect` is the LWT value and is set by the station at CONNECT, so it can only ever describe a drop the station did not choose. `PlannedShutdown` is published by the station itself, on its own topic, immediately before it sends a clean MQTT DISCONNECT — a clean DISCONNECT suppresses the will, so without this value a station shutting down on purpose has no way to say so and the server learns nothing until the heartbeat timeout.
